newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL-Trygg-Hansa H1 profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Trygg-Hansa H1 profit seen higher.

text.p: Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa was expected to post a pre-tax profit of 1.94 billion crowns in the first half of 1997, a Reuters poll of five analysts showed on Monday.
The company posted a profit of 1.52 billion crowns in the same period a year ago.
Forecasts varied between 1.62 and 2.20 billion crowns.
For the full year analysts forecast a profit of 2.41 billion crowns against 2.43 billion crowns in 1996.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Enskilda, Handelsbanken, Nordiska, and Penser.
Trygg-Hansa is due to release its half year report on August 19.
